sourceClaims.claim: underline, pill and boxed are distinct source families with 61/40/39px geometry
width is label/content-driven and source does not define a mobile collapse policy
TabsController uses automatic activation with roving tabindex; consumers own overflow layout

evidence.source-integrity: pass: all three primary SVG families and their state geometry remain traced by source tests
evidence.structural-contract: pass: tablist/tab/tabpanel relationships and controller export are asserted
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: real click updates selection, roving tabindex and panel visibility; disabled forced-click/programmatic activation are no-ops; ArrowLeft/Right, Home/End, root-owned activation, replacement, repeated enhancement and teardown execute
evidence.accessibility: pass: exactly one selected/tab-stop tab, disabled pointer/programmatic exclusion, focus movement, detached-tree IDs and root-scoped unique ARIA relationships are checked
evidence.focused-visual: pass: component-local active, inactive, real focus and narrow long-label states are captured
evidence.consumer-integration: not-applicable: no application-owned or Data Workspace Tabs consumer exists on this baseline
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: overflow and wrapping policy are consumer-owned; the narrow composition is additional integration evidence only

findings.description: Repeated or direct construction could leave competing controllers, initial selection did not exclude native disabled, document-scoped validation rejected detached roots, programmatic activation accepted foreign tabs, and malformed or cross-root ARIA relationships were accepted silently.

knownLimitations: overflow, wrapping and responsive navigation policy are consumer-owned
pill and boxed Showcase matrices are static style fixtures without panels
